title: Personnel File Excerpt
summary: This document discusses an individual's employment history with the CIA, including assignments in Panama, Washington D.C., Havana, and Guatemala. It also mentions security concerns related to alleged affairs in Cuba and a relationship with an individual wanted by the FBI.
